"Presses down fruits and flowers into jars of fruit and dye. Requires jars to be inputted in one input."

The Press Machine is used to press either flowers or fruits to make dyes or jam respectively. The Press machine requires jars to function.

Pressing items into jars quadruples its original price.

Trivia

  • Each internal storage holds 25 items equating to 6.25 items per section of the display.
  • It has 24 different dyes you can make, while it has 11 different jams you can make.
    • There are 35 different items you can press using a press machine.
